```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# setup chunk to set global options and load in libraries
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, stringr, shiny, readr)
```

```{r loading_data}
# dropbox direct download link to access large file (+2gb)
dataset_url <- "https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/os1x9i7sx1io5ura5fjti/311_DATA.csv?rlkey=quw01tcso6lz3u3vtx7seoalc&st=634psn3v&dl=1"

# read CSV directly from Dropbox
data <- read_csv(dataset_url)

# show first few rows to make sure data was read in correctly1
head(data)
```

```{r}
# Convert date columns to Date format
data$`Created Date` <- as.Date(data$`Created Date`, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
data$`Closed Date` <- as.Date(data$`Closed Date`, format = "%m/%d/%Y")

missing_dates <- sum(is.na(data$`Created Date`) | is.na(data$`Closed Date`))
cat("Missing date values:", missing_dates, "\n")

#calculating the duration, ensuring no NA values are involved
data$Duration <- as.numeric(difftime(data$`Closed Date`, data$`Created Date`, units = "days"))

data <- data[!is.na(data$Duration), ]

```


```{r}
data_1 <- data[data$Duration >= 0, ]  # removing negative duration (how is this even possoble)
summary(data_1$Duration)
```

```{r}
#creating plot

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

data_1 %>%
  group_by(Borough) %>%
  summarise(Total_Duration = sum(Duration, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Borough, -Total_Duration), y = Total_Duration, fill = Borough)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Total Duration by Borough", x = "Borough", y = "Total Duration (Days)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```
